title: A new use case is written, built and shown proved
steps: On a fresh product repo, writes a use case with its requirement, flow and tests.
Writes the command it needs with its handler, and the files that build and test it.
Records each test as automated with its file.
Reads the use case requirement's Traceability.
expected_result: The check finds no errors and no gaps for the use case, and its requirement reads proved.

title: A new product repo set up with Lathe checks clean with its outcomes and domains
steps: In a fresh folder, sets up Lathe and writes the first product record.
Writes two business outcomes and a domain with a capability serving them.
expected_result: The check finds no errors, and the outcomes and domain read back as written.

title: A product written for the last Lathe moves to the new one and checks clean
steps: In a fresh product repo with data for the last Lathe, moves the product to the new Lathe.
Reads what it changed and what it left to do by hand, and does each by hand.
expected_result: The move is one reviewable change and the check finds no errors on the new Lathe.

title: A change asked of Claude in the chat is made, reviewed and kept
steps: In the desktop app on a one-domain product, asks Claude in the chat to add a use case.
Claude adds it through the product's commands and runs the check.
The Owner puts the turn's records under review and steps through each with its diff.
expected_result: The new use case is in the product's data, the check finds no errors, and the review leaves it in place.

title: A new Reader finds the code and tests behind a requirement they are given
steps: Opens the app on a product the Reader has not seen, given one requirement.
Finds the requirement's record in its domain.
Opens it and follows its links to what designs and builds it.
Reads its Traceability and names the code files and the tests.
expected_result: The Reader names the code and the tests behind the requirement, in under five minutes.
